prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI problem library catalogue concept
Input image role: source screenshot is a reference for default problem list state only.
Primary request: Redesign 06-C-02-problem-list/default.
Direction: library catalogue.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Treat the page like a quiet catalogue: clear type filters, precise search and select filters, recommended-only switch, result count, compact row list optimized for scanning, monochrome document icons, neutral chips, right-aligned start actions, and pagination at bottom.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design List/Table hybrid, Input, Select, Switch, Pagination, Button UI.
Color palette: #f4f4f5 page canvas, #ffffff list surface, #ececee chips/dividers, #09090b row start buttons, #71717a helper text.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans, compact scan-friendly hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: filter/result relationship must be clear; no large decorative problem cards; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, AI gradients, colorful buttons, heavy card shadows, over-rounded workspace bubbles, watermark.
